problem_description: API Public Contracts & Pydantic v2 validation absence in endpoints /api/v4/cierre/desglose, /api/v4/exec/summary, and associated endpoints.
root_cause: Organic growth of endpoints during UX1.0 sprints without formal Pydantic v2 entry/exit schemas causing potential risk of frontend-backend decoupling.
strategy: Define explicit Pydantic v2 schemas for all executive summary and financial structure endpoints (PerMarketplaceMetrics, ExecSummaryResponse, FinancialStructureResponse, ExecWaterfallResponse, DocumentaryCoverageResponse, PeriodoItem, DteCountResponse) and decorate endpoints with response_model.
rollback_strategy: git checkout -- api/api.py tests/test_benchmarks.py tests/test_certification_gate.py tests/test_regression_contracts.py
